title: A wider oscillator swing
hook: Change amplitude and predict maximum speed.
misconception: maximum speed stays fixed when amplitude doubles.
objective: Apply v_max = ωA to compare maximum speed when amplitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With simple harmonic motion with fixed angular frequency, v_max = ωA. When amplitude doubles, maximum speed becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model v_max = ωA; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider simple harmonic motion with fixed angular frequency, with a nonzero initial result. If amplitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on maximum speed?
recall.why: Apply v_max = ωA under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
